# 起信論疏記會閱卷首

**ID:** X0767
**Volume:** X45
**Category:** 論集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋論部／起信論疏
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0767

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-*juǎn* prefatory volume (*juànshǒu* 卷首) to the larger 10-*juǎn* *Qǐxìn lùn shūjì huìyuè* [KR6o0120](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0120) (X45n768), produced by the early-Qing Huáyán-school revivalist [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) Xùfǎ (Bótíng) (1641–1728). The catalog meta entry has no listed author for this front-matter volume separately, but the work is the integral *juànshǒu* of the larger compilation by Xùfǎ.

**Abstract**

The volume contains the editorial apparatus for the *Huì-yuè*: a *fán-lì* 凡例 (editorial conventions), a *yuán-qǐ* 緣起 (origin), a *kē-pàn* 科判 (structural outline), a "biography of the five [Huáyán] patriarchs" (五祖傳), an abbreviated record of the treatise's author (論主略錄, i.e., Aśvaghoṣa) and of the principal commentator ([法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng — 記主略錄), a Dharma-characteristic numerical key (法相數), and a "True/False Arising-and-Perishing Dharma-Characteristic Diagram" (真妄生滅法相圖). The *kē-pàn* maps the structure of the composite *huì-yuè* across its 10 *juǎn*: *juǎn* 1 covers the prefaces and the title-analyses; *juǎn* 2–10 covers the running text of the *Qǐ-xìn lùn* divided according to the standard Huáyán scholastic *kē-wén*.

This *juànshǒu* is essentially the front matter required for orienting a student to the *huìyuè* as a study tool — a standard front-end for a major scholastic compilation in the Huáyán tradition. Composition window: Xùfǎ's mature career, 1670–1728.
